props.name: actionsRef
props.description: A ref to imperative actions. - `unmount`: Manually unmounts the menu. Call this after any externally controlled closing animation finishes. - `close`: When specified, the menu can be closed imperatively.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the menu. This can be a regular React node or a render function that receives the `payload` of the active trigger.

props.name: closeParentOnEsc
props.description: When in a submenu, determines whether pressing the Escape key closes the entire menu, or only the current child menu.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the menu is initially open.

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger that the menu is associated with. This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open menu.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: handle
props.description: A handle to associate the menu with a trigger. If specified, allows external triggers to control the menu's open state.

props.name: highlightItemOnHover
props.description: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them. Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: modal
props.description: Determines if the menu enters a modal state when open. - `true`: user interaction is limited to the menu: document page scroll is locked and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled. - `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the menu is opened or closed.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the menu is opened or closed.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the menu is currently open.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The visual orientation of the menu. Controls whether roving focus uses up/down or left/right arrow keys.

props.name: triggerId
props.description: ID of the trigger that the menu is associated with. This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled menu. There's no need to specify this prop when the menu is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

props.name: checked

props.description: Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

props.name: anchor
props.type: Element | VirtualElement | RefObject<Element | null> | (() => Element | VirtualElement | null)
props.description: An element to position the popup against. By default, the popup will be positioned against the trigger.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description: Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.

props.name: disableAnchorTracking
props.description: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | HTMLElement | null | void)
props.description: Determines the element to focus when the menu is closed.

props.name: positionMethod
props.description: Determines which CSS `position` property to use.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against. May automatically change to avoid collisions.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels. Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after the anchor element was scrolled out of view.
